query: SELECT n.value AS collective,h.stream_id AS runtime_parent_stream,h.task_type AS parent_task_type,COUNT(*) AS matches,COUNT(DISTINCT o.opId) AS distinct_ops FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=o.opType JOIN runtime.HostTask h ON h.connection_id=o.connectionId GROUP BY n.value,h.stream_id,h.task_type ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 20
